summaries.title: Loopy: Taming Audio-Driven Portrait Avatar with Long-Term Motion Dependency
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」痛点，作者围绕 **Loopy** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖扩散模型（Diffusion Model）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we propose an end-to-end audio-only conditioned video diffusion model named Loopy。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In this paper, we propose an end-to-end audio-only conditioned video diffusion model named Loopy。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive experiments show that Loopy outperforms recent audio-driven portrait diffusion models, delivering more lifelike and high-quality results across various scenarios）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为社区高关注度代表作（HF 97 赞），本工作为突破 **视频生成与交互世界模型 (Video & World Models)** 中的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用线性复杂度递归状态/注意力融合架构、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **A100**。实验设计与验证细节：In this paper, we adapt the model architecture to a hybrid of Mamba and Transformer blocks, approach data construction with both temporal and spatial...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Especially, it could process nearly a thousand images on a single A100 80GB GPU, showing promising application prospects for a wide range of tasks）。

summaries.title: LongCite: Enabling LLMs to Generate Fine-grained Citations in Long-context QA
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「模型幻觉、事实失真与长程一致性退化、系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **LongCite** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)）、模型幻觉（Hallucination），并引入 Long-Context Question Answering with
Citations (LQAC) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：To this end, we propose CoF (Coarse to Fine), a novel pipeline that utilizes off-the-shelf LLMs to automatically generate long-context QA instances with precise...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **8B, 9B**。实验设计与验证细节：We first introduce LongBench-Cite, an automated benchmark for assessing current LLMs' performance in Long-Context Question Answering with Citations (LQAC),...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（The evaluation results on LongBench-Cite show that our trained models achieve state-of-the-art citation quality, surpassing advanced proprietary models including GPT-4o）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 48 赞），本工作为突破 **监督微调与参数高效适配 (SFT/LoRA)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「模型幻觉、事实失真与长程一致性退化」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: MMMU-Pro: A More Robust Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding Benchmark
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于评测基准与数据集。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **MMMU-Pro** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖思维链（Chain-of-Thought (CoT)），并引入 Massive
Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning (MMMU) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：This paper introduces MMMU-Pro, a robust version of the Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning (MMMU) benchmark。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **MMMU-Pro, MMMU**。实验设计与验证细节：This paper introduces MMMU-Pro, a robust version of the Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning (MMMU) benchmark。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **from 16.8% to 26.9%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Results show that model performance is substantially lower on MMMU-Pro than on MMMU, ranging from 16.8% to 26.9% across models）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 33 赞），本工作可作为评估 **思维链与树搜索 (CoT & Search)、文档解析、OCR与GUI感知 (Doc/GUI)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；提供项目主页与可视化案例参考。

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Finally, we introduce a real-world dataset with 10 tasks across Activities of Daily Living to test our framework。
